name: Bromsgrove Emergency Food Support
description: Bromsgrove District Council operates emergency food support including food parcels. Based at Bromsgrove Community Hub. Open Mon-Fri 9am-5pm for referrals and collections. Self-referral accepted.

name: Bromsgrove Town Council Allotments
description: Bromsgrove Town Council manages allotments at Austin Road
likes: and Stourbridge Road. Plots from £35 per year. Waiting lists available. Contact the council office.

name: Bromsgrove Community Garden
short_description: Community garden at St Chads Avenue
description: Volunteer-run community garden with 30 vegetable plots and a communal herb area. Open to visitors during Sunday mornings. Part of Bromsgrove Community Action group. Contact: community.garden@bromsgrove.org.
